headline: DeepSeek flash model hits #1; Xiaomi's new release rockets 19 spots
summary: DeepSeek's v4.1-flash-20260910 claimed the top spot with 14.2% token share, bumping Zhipu AI to #2 after a 3.3% drop. Xiaomi's mimo-v2.6-flash-20260921 made a stunning 19-rank leap to #7 on its debut, setting an all-time record at 2.9% share. OpenAI's new gpt-6-luna model entered at #12 with a 30-rank jump, while five models dropped out entirely.
highlights: DeepSeek + Zhipu AI + OpenAI now command 53.2% of tokens combined
Xiaomi's mimo-v2.6-flash debuts at rank 7 with 2.9% share—a new all-time high for the model
OpenAI's gpt-6-luna-20260922 vaults 30 ranks to #12 in a single day (2.1% share)
Five models dropped from the top 51: Nex AGI, Qwen, xAI, Anthropic, and Google variants
DeepSeek's provider share grew 0.9% day-over-day to 24.2%, extending its lead
